The '''Daminia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daminia]].
